description: Video thumbnail. Grab a frame for a cover or preview. Exactly one frame is decoded, so an hour of video costs no more than a minute. Accepts video/*, .mp4, .mov, .mkv, .webm, .avi, .m4v; up to 500 MB per file.

at.description: Which moment. Leave empty and we pick one, not the very first second

outputDir.description: Where to put the results. Defaults to the folder each source file came from. Existing files are never overwritten.

paths.description: Paths to the files to process, absolute or relative to the working directory.

width.description: Width in pixels. 0 keeps the original

name: video_thumbnail
